correctness.rationale: Diagonalization follows directly from Gaussian monomial orthogonality; the cosine integral is an absolutely integrated hypergeometric series. The gamma CLT and delta method yield the fixed-frequency attenuation exp(-omega²/2). An O(sqrt N) Weyl character-sum bound proves 1D rational/irrational and 2D triangular/square empirical limits. Fourier orthogonality for coprime p,q forces first mixed constant term at p+q, with exactly two conjugate contributions giving binomial(p+q,p) A^p B^q /2^(3(p+q)-1). Compact phase subgroup images give 1D Fredholm essential interval and simultaneous cosine minima if and only if p,q odd; eta=2 derivative and e^(3/2)>4 give the stated interval. The proof correctly withholds the 2D Fredholm essential spectrum claim because boundary strips can change it. 388 deterministic checker assertions corroborate formulas, not infinite claims.
